|errata_history=This is version PC-E1 of [[Fallen Jedi]], a title change (Fallen Jedi → Maris Brood, Fallen Jedi) with a lore change; it is the current card. The images are the Master List slip and the Players Committee card image, which print it. The release-sheet slip prints •Fallen Jedi; see [[Fallen Jedi]].
* '''Original''' ([[Fallen Jedi]]): titled “•Fallen Jedi” (lore “With only a few Jedi remaining in the galaxy, each confrontation between them has far reaching consequences. Female.”) on the Virtual Block 4 release sheet, slip 67: “Matching weapon is Elegant Lightsaber, and, if Sai'torr Kal Fas on table, may lose 2 Force to ▼ it on her. While with Galen or a [Sidious] Effect, adds one battle destiny. Immune to [Permanent Weapon] weapons and attrition < 5.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=8 Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 8, slip 67. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=8 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-67-Maris_Brood_Fallen_Jedi.png]]) prints it. The PC website card list still showed the card under this title from 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013.<ref name="cl-1240_66-old">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001437/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111144021/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive; the same in the VMasterType list): “Fallen Jedi”</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): On 29 January 2013 the [[Players Committee]] announced the persona-name change “Fallen Jedi ---> Maris Brood”, effective immediately (old slips stayed tournament-legal; non-gameplay lore was removed; “Each of the cards will retain their gametext and characteristics”)<ref name="persona2013">[https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 New Persona Changes], [[Players Committee]], 29 January 2013. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive].</ref>. The PC website card list shows the new title by 15 March 2013 (the last capture with the old title is of 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-1240_66-new">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20130315122117/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2013-03-15] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130429051930/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2013-04-29] (Internet Archive): “Maris Brood, Fallen Jedi” (these captures carry no game text)</ref>, and the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 11) prints the card as “•Maris Brood, Fallen Jedi” (no lore)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=11, page 11. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=11 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Matching weapon is Elegant Lightsaber, and, if Sai'torr Kal Fas on table, may lose 2 Force to ▼ it on her. While with Galen or a [Sidious] Effect, adds one battle destiny. Immune to [Permanent Weapon] weapons and attrition < 5.” The game text did not change. The PC website card list (2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11, titled “Fallen Jedi”) writes the ▼ out and has “Elegant Lightsaber and, if” without the first comma (icon notation and punctuation only, not counted as a separate version). The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1240-66-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-L-marisbroodfallenjedi-pre.gif]]) print it.
